title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, face, chest burst, zigzags, legs, feet, BB)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes_title: v5: one-piece beak, less round head
notes: v5. Beak: the upper and lower halves now join at the back into one piece, like the costume. The mouth opens only toward the front. Head: no longer a ball. It's a taller, narrower top over fuller cheeks and jaw (a pear shape), and the cap follows the new shape. The white face is now one plate around the eyes, running up under the cap so the cap rim is its top edge, like the white face under the brim in the photo. The eyes sit on the new head surface. The body, wings and feet are as in v4. Check: the head shape, how far back the mouth opens, and the white face plate.
